messages:
michelle: quick sync on prefix/prompt cache contract. current prod responses look like:

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Cache-Control: private, max-age=60
X-Redwood-Prefix-Cache: HIT; ttl=34
{ "text": "..." }
```

we need a stable contract for infra and SDKs. two quick questions:
1) headers/fields: boolean hit indicator vs only meta blob?
2) cache key composition: which request params are canonical? specifically are sampling params part of key?

aj: for clarity / adoption i prefer explicit boolean + TTL header. proposed minimal surface:
- `X-Prefix-Cache-Hit: 1` or `0`
- `X-Prefix-Cache-TTL: 34`  (seconds)
and keep `Cache-Control: private, max-age=60` so intermediaries behave.

on key composition: include model id, normalized prefix (trim & collapse whitespace), route, stop tokens, and an "output_schema" id when present. exclude sampling params (temperature, top_p, seed). sampling increases miss rate a lot and most clients expect semantics where sampling only affects non-cached responses.

satvik: +1 to excluding temp/top_p. important to document that cached output may be returned even if sampling differs; provide opt-out mechanism. suggestion: clients can send `cache: false` or `prefix_version` to force bypassing cache.

lina: on invalidation / rollouts for prompt fixes: options:
- rely on TTL only (short lifetimes)
- `prefix_version` request field to namespace keys for controlled rollout
- admin invalidate API for evicting keys by prefix hash
I prefer `prefix_version` as the default for staged rollouts, plus an admin invalidate for emergency sweeps.

aj: implementation note: we can accept `prefix_version` in request JSON or query, default empty string. server will fold it into the key namespace. backward compatible.

michelle: do we want an in-band JSON field so SDKs on mobile/web don't have to read headers? e.g. `cache_meta: { hit: true, ttl: 34 }`

tomas: recommend both for now: header for infra and `cache_meta` in body for SDK ergonomics. to avoid forcing schema changes on all clients immediately, gate `cache_meta` behind an opt-in query flag `accept_cache_meta=true`. proposed body fragment when enabled:
```
"cache_meta": {"hit": true, "ttl": 34, "scope": "prefix"}
```
make sure this is optional.

lina: also propose `X-Prefix-Cache-Reason` as a short enum for misses: e.g. `miss_ttl_expired`, `version_mismatch`, `no_key`, `opt_out`. helps debugging without leaking internals.

aj: fine with the reason header as a small set of values. do not expose internal errors.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded: inference-service v2026.3.12 (prefix-cache changes) - build #4892

michelle: action list:
- aj: PR (RFC) to define headers: `X-Prefix-Cache-Hit`, `X-Prefix-Cache-TTL`, `X-Prefix-Cache-Reason` + Cache-Control guidance. include `prefix_version` field and `accept_cache_meta` opt-in (ETA: tomorrow). @aj
- docs: i'll draft SDK examples for header + in-band `cache_meta` once PR lands
- ops: lina/tomas to propose admin invalidation API and expected auth semantics
- eng: note in release notes that sampling params are excluded from key by default and show `cache: false` escape hatch

michelle: one more UX note: recommend small TTL default (30-60s) for prefix cache to balance rollouts and hit rate. longer TTLs ok if model/prompt stable.

thanks all :thumbsup:
